title: ModerationRuleInput
description: Body of POST /moderation-rules and PUT /moderation-rules/{ruleId}. PUT replaces the rule: omitted `pattern`, `streaming` and `project_id` are cleared; omitted `enabled` is left unchanged (true on create). A `pattern` is a 422 unless category is `regex`. Unknown keys are a 422.

slug.description: Unique among this workspace's rules. The rule's identity in traces; changing it renames the rule there.

pattern.description: RE2 regex (lookarounds and backreferences are rejected); required when category is `regex`, must be absent or null otherwise.

streaming.description: Per-rule override of the organisation streaming default; null or omitted inherits it.

project_id.description: A project of this workspace (proj_12) to scope the rule to it; null or omitted = every project in the workspace. A project from another workspace is a 422.

enabled.description: Absent = true on create, unchanged on update or replace. Boolean only: null is a 422.

id.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.

workspace_id.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.

created_at.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.

updated_at.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.
